SRC-323:R001.text: A substantial handoff is evaluated against the current implementation and canonical history BEFORE redundant Work is created.

SRC-323:R002.text: Already-satisfied clauses are supported by real current evidence, never by semantic similarity or an agent narrative.

SRC-323:R003.text: Missing, defective or unverified clauses remain actionable and are not swallowed by a duplicate verdict.
